highlights: Sign in to Vercel and other OAuth MCP servers again after you upgrade. After that, they stay signed in.
Set what an agent may do with one Permissions setting: Workspace only, Ask first or Full access.
Hide an agent that you do not use now, and restore it later with its thread and files.
Ask the agent a side question, and quote text from a message in a new message.
Gemini connects on Windows when its server starts slowly, and OpenBot opens faster.
